perf: reduce primitive serialization overhead (#77)

Primitive array elements and object properties enter recursive serializers
even though they need no traversal. Share primitive formatting across
serialization modes while preserving toJSON ordering and per-value error
handling in safe mode.

Native string escaping becomes faster at shorter string lengths on
Node.js 22 and later. Select the cutoff once at module load so older
runtimes retain their existing fast
